summary: A capable, cheap model family that forced US labs to talk about price. Procurement and data rules decide if you can use it.
body: DeepSeek mattered because it made frontier-ish quality available at API prices that embarrassed the $20/seat club. The consumer chat app is free with no paid subscription; API access is strictly pay-per-use. If you ship a product on the API, run a latency and data-residency check before you celebrate the invoice—many Western companies will not clear security review.
notes: Read the privacy policy before any customer data
Good as a backup model in a router, not always as a brand assistant
Quality varies by distillation versus full-size endpoints
